    rHessian_11             : REAL := 0.0;      (* Diagonal Element H11 for Backpressure Choke *)

    (* ===================================================================================== *)

    rNotch_x1 : REAL := 220.0; rNotch_x2 : REAL := 220.0; (* Input delay line *)

    c_rNotch_b0 : REAL := 0.9525; c_rNotch_b1 : REAL := -1.8120; c_rNotch_b2 : REAL := 0.9525;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* EXECUTION LOGIC - DETERMINISTIC 50 MS CYCLIC TASK START                                   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 1.0 SIL-3 HARDWIRED EMERGENCY STOP & MASTER INTERLOCK EVALUATION                          *)
(* Active-High Fail-Safe Dual-Channel Relay Monitored Directly. Immediate Trip Execution.    *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemRunning                  := FALSE;
    bSystemReady                    := FALSE;
    bSystemTrip                     := TRUE;
    rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm        := 0.0;
    rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct    := 12.0; (* Safe Controlled Venting Position to Avoid Overpressure *)
    rSaltBlowdownValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
    rHERT_SpeedDemand_rpm           := 0.0;
    rLetdownStage2Demand_pct        := 25.0; (* Controlled Depressurization to Intermediate Vessel *)
    rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW     := 0.0;
    rQuenchInjectionValveDemand_pct := 100.0; (* Open Emergency Quench to Stop Runaway Exotherms *)
    rSaltWashWaterPumpDemand_pct    := 0.0;
    
    (* Assert Critical Trip Alarm Bits in dwAlarmWord_1 *)
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: SIL-3 Hardware E-Stop Circuit Open *)
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#8000_0000; (* Bit 31: System Trip Latched *)
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_FFFE; (* Clear Bit 0: System Running = 0 *)
    
    iActiveState := 90; (* Jump to STATE_90_EMERGENCY_BLOWDOWN_TRIP *)
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING & HEALTH EVALUATION                    *)
(* Evaluates Discrepancy Limits, Median Selection, and Graceful 1oo2 Degraded Fallback.      *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- 2.1 Reactor Backpressure 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bPress_A_OK := (rFeedPumpDischPress_A >= 10.0) AND (rFeedPumpDischPress_A <= 280.0);
bPress_B_OK := (rFeedPumpDischPress_B >= 10.0) AND (rFeedPumpDischPress_B <= 280.0);
bPress_C_OK := (rFeedPumpDischPress_C >= 10.0) AND (rFeedPumpDischPress_C <= 280.0);

IF bPress_A_OK AND bPress_B_OK AND bPress_C_OK THEN
    (* Check Pairwise Deviations *)
    IF (ABS(rFeedPumpDischPress_A - rFeedPumpDischPress_B) <= c_rPressDiscrepancyLimit_bar) AND
       (ABS(rFeedPumpDischPress_B - rFeedPumpDischPress_C) <= c_rPressDiscrepancyLimit_bar) AND
       (ABS(rFeedPumpDischPress_A - rFeedPumpDischPress_C) <= c_rPressDiscrepancyLimit_bar) THEN
        (* All Three Transmitters Fully Consistent: Compute Median *)
        IF (rFeedPumpDischPress_A >= rFeedPumpDischPress_B AND rFeedPumpDischPress_A <= rFeedPumpDischPress_C) OR
           (rFeedPumpDischPress_A >= rFeedPumpDischPress_C AND rFeedPumpDischPress_A <= rFeedPumpDischPress_B) THEN
            rVotedReactorPress := rFeedPumpDischPress_A;
        ELSIF (rFeedPumpDischPress_B >= rFeedPumpDischPress_A AND rFeedPumpDischPress_B <= rFeedPumpDischPress_C) OR
              (rFeedPumpDischPress_B >= rFeedPumpDischPress_C AND rFeedPumpDischPress_B <= rFeedPumpDischPress_A) THEN
            rVotedReactorPress := rFeedPumpDischPress_B;
        ELSE
            rVotedReactorPress := rFeedPumpDischPress_C;
        END_IF;
        bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    ELSE
        (* Sensor Discrepancy Detected: Identify Outlier Channel and Fallback to 1oo2 Mean of Closest Pair *)
        IF ABS(rFeedPumpDischPress_A - rFeedPumpDischPress_B) <= c_rPressDiscrepancyLimit_bar THEN
            rVotedReactorPress := (rFeedPumpDischPress_A + rFeedPumpDischPress_B) * 0.5;
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Channel C Pressure Discrepant *)
        ELSIF ABS(rFeedPumpDischPress_A - rFeedPumpDischPress_C) <= c_rPressDiscrepancyLimit_bar THEN
            rVotedReactorPress := (rFeedPumpDischPress_A + rFeedPumpDischPress_C) * 0.5;
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Channel B Pressure Discrepant *)
        ELSE
            rVotedReactorPress := (rFeedPumpDischPress_B + rFeedPumpDischPress_C) * 0.5;
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Channel A Pressure Discrepant *)
        END_IF;
        bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bPress_A_OK AND bPress_B_OK THEN
    rVotedReactorPress := (rFeedPumpDischPress_A + rFeedPumpDischPress_B) * 0.5;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Pressure Sensor C Hard Failure *)
ELSIF bPress_A_OK AND bPress_C_OK THEN
    rVotedReactorPress := (rFeedPumpDischPress_A + rFeedPumpDischPress_C) * 0.5;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Pressure Sensor B Hard Failure *)
ELSIF bPress_B_OK AND bPress_C_OK THEN
    rVotedReactorPress := (rFeedPumpDischPress_B + rFeedPumpDischPress_C) * 0.5;
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Pressure Sensor A Hard Failure *)
ELSE
    (* Catastrophic 2oo3 Loss: Less Than 2 Transmitters Healthy -> Mandatory SIS Trip *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Dual/Triple Pressure Sensor Loss *)
    iActiveState := 90;
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Reactor Core Temperature 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bTemp_A_OK := (rReactorCoreTemp_A >= 15.0) AND (rReactorCoreTemp_A <= 450.0);
bTemp_B_OK := (rReactorCoreTemp_B >= 15.0) AND (rReactorCoreTemp_B <= 450.0);
bTemp_C_OK := (rReactorCoreTemp_C >= 15.0) AND (rReactorCoreTemp_C <= 450.0);

IF bTemp_A_OK AND bTemp_B_OK AND bTemp_C_OK THEN
    IF (ABS(rReactorCoreTemp_A - rReactorCoreTemp_B) <= c_rTempDiscrepancyLimit_degC) AND
       (ABS(rReactorCoreTemp_B - rReactorCoreTemp_C) <= c_rTempDiscrepancyLimit_degC) AND
       (ABS(rReactorCoreTemp_A - rReactorCoreTemp_C) <= c_rTempDiscrepancyLimit_degC) THEN
        (* All Three Temperature Thermocouples Consistent: Compute Median *)
        IF (rReactorCoreTemp_A >= rReactorCoreTemp_B AND rReactorCoreTemp_A <= rReactorCoreTemp_C) OR
           (rReactorCoreTemp_A >= rReactorCoreTemp_C AND rReactorCoreTemp_A <= rReactorCoreTemp_B) THEN
            rVotedReactorTemp := rReactorCoreTemp_A;
        ELSIF (rReactorCoreTemp_B >= rReactorCoreTemp_A AND rReactorCoreTemp_B <= rReactorCoreTemp_C) OR
              (rReactorCoreTemp_B >= rReactorCoreTemp_C AND rReactorCoreTemp_B <= rReactorCoreTemp_A) THEN
            rVotedReactorTemp := rReactorCoreTemp_B;
        ELSE
            rVotedReactorTemp := rReactorCoreTemp_C;
        END_IF;
        bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    ELSE
        (* Sensor Drift Detected in Thermocouples *)
        IF ABS(rReactorCoreTemp_A - rReactorCoreTemp_B) <= c_rTempDiscrepancyLimit_degC THEN
            rVotedReactorTemp := (rReactorCoreTemp_A + rReactorCoreTemp_B) * 0.5;
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Thermocouple C Drift *)
        ELSIF ABS(rReactorCoreTemp_A - rReactorCoreTemp_C) <= c_rTempDiscrepancyLimit_degC THEN
            rVotedReactorTemp := (rReactorCoreTemp_A + rReactorCoreTemp_C) * 0.5;
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0040; (* Thermocouple B Drift *)
        ELSE
            rVotedReactorTemp := (rReactorCoreTemp_B + rReactorCoreTemp_C) * 0.5;
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* Thermocouple A Drift *)
        END_IF;
        bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bTemp_A_OK AND bTemp_B_OK THEN
    rVotedReactorTemp := (rReactorCoreTemp_A + rReactorCoreTemp_B) * 0.5;
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_A_OK AND bTemp_C_OK THEN
    rVotedReactorTemp := (rReactorCoreTemp_A + rReactorCoreTemp_C) * 0.5;
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bTemp_B_OK AND bTemp_C_OK THEN
    rVotedReactorTemp := (rReactorCoreTemp_B + rReactorCoreTemp_C) * 0.5;
    bTemp_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Dual/Triple Temperature Sensor Loss *)
    iActiveState := 90;
    iState := 90;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

bDegradedMode := bPress_Degraded_1oo2 OR bTemp_Degraded_1oo2;

(* --- 2.3 Cyclone Differential Pressure Filtering --- *)
rVotedCycloneDiffP := rCycloneDiffPress_bar;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 DIGITAL BIQUAD NOTCH FILTER: PUMP DISCHARGE PULSATION ATTENUATION                     *)
(* Rejects 10 Hz quintuplex positive displacement pulsation ripples from backpressure signal*)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rFilteredPulsationPress :=
    c_rNotch_b0 * rVotedReactorPress +
    c_rNotch_b1 * rNotch_x1 +
    c_rNotch_b2 * rNotch_x2 -
    c_rNotch_a1 * rNotch_y1 -
    c_rNotch_a2 * rNotch_y2;

(* Advance Delay Lines *)
rNotch_x2 := rNotch_x1;
rNotch_x1 := rVotedReactorPress;
rNotch_y2 := rNotch_y1;
rNotch_y1 := rFilteredPulsationPress;

rInstantaneousPulsationAmpl := ABS(rVotedReactorPress - rFilteredPulsationPress);
IF rInstantaneousPulsationAmpl > 14.5 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0200; (* Severe Pump Pulsation: Damper Bladder Failure *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 SLURRY NON-NEWTONIAN RHEOLOGY & PLUG-FLOW HYDRAULIC ENGINE                            *)
(* Computes Herschel-Bulkley wall shear stress, apparent viscosity, and line friction drop. *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute Core Temperature in Kelvin *)
rCoreTempKelvin := rVotedReactorTemp + 273.15;

(* Slurry Superficial Flow Velocity inside Reactor Tube: v = Q_mass / (rho * A_pipe * 3600) *)
rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms := rSlurryMassFlowRate / (rSlurryFeedDensity * 0.00456037 * 3600.0);
IF rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms < 0.01 THEN
    rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms := 0.01; (* Clamp to prevent numerical division by zero *)
END_IF;

(* Pipe Wall Superficial Shear Rate: gamma_dot = (8 * v / D) * ((3n + 1) / (4n)) *)
rSlurryShearRate_gamma := (8.0 * rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms / c_rReactorTubeDiameter_m) *
    ((3.0 * c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n + 1.0) / (4.0 * c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n));

(* In-situ Bingham/Herschel-Bulkley Yield Stress Scaling with Total Dry Solids % *)
rTmpDelta := c_rBaseYieldStress_tau0 * EXP(c_rSolidsYieldStressSlope * (rFeedSlurryDrySolids_pct - 15.0));

(* Pipe Wall Shear Stress: tau_w = tau_0 + K * (gamma_dot)^n *)
rHerschelBulkleyTau_w := rTmpDelta + c_rBaseConsistencyIndex_K * EXPT(rSlurryShearRate_gamma, c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n);

(* Apparent Dynamic Viscosity: mu_app = tau_w / gamma_dot in [Pa*s], convert to [cP] *)
rRheologicalApparentViscosity_cP := (rHerschelBulkleyTau_w / rSlurryShearRate_gamma) * 1000.0;

(* Generalized Non-Newtonian Reynolds Number Re_HB *)
rReynoldsNumber_HB := (rSlurryFeedDensity * EXPT(rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms, 2.0 - c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n) *
    EXPT(c_rReactorTubeDiameter_m, c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n)) /
    (c_rBaseConsistencyIndex_K * EXPT((3.0 * c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n + 1.0) / (4.0 * c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n), c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n) *
     EXPT(8.0, c_rFlowBehaviorIndex_n - 1.0));

(* Friction Factor Calculation *)
IF rReynoldsNumber_HB < 2100.0 THEN
    (* Laminar Non-Newtonian Flow: f = 64 / Re_HB *)
    rPipeFrictionFactor_f := 64.0 / rReynoldsNumber_HB;
ELSE
    (* Turbulent Swamee-Aggarwal Approximation *)
    rPipeFrictionFactor_f := 0.3164 / EXPT(rReynoldsNumber_HB, 0.25);
END_IF;

(* Slurry Hydraulic Line Pressure Drop across 120m Reactor Tube [bar] *)
rTmpB := (rPipeFrictionFactor_f * (c_rReactorLength_m / c_rReactorTubeDiameter_m) *
    (rSlurryFeedDensity * rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms * rSlurryFlowVelocity_ms * 0.5)) / 100000.0;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 SUPERCRITICAL WATER DIELECTRIC COLLAPSE & INORGANIC SALT PRECIPITATION KINETICS       *)
(* Evaluates Dielectric Permittivity epsilon_r, Mineral Precipitation Rate & Cyclone Vortex. *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Water Relative Permittivity (Dielectric Constant epsilon_r) Approximation at 220 bar *)
IF rVotedReactorTemp <= 100.0 THEN
    rWaterDielectricConstantEst := 78.5 - 0.35 * (rVotedReactorTemp - 20.0);
ELSIF rVotedReactorTemp <= 300.0 THEN
    rWaterDielectricConstantEst := 50.5 - 0.17 * (rVotedReactorTemp - 100.0);
ELSIF rVotedReactorTemp <= 373.9 THEN
    (* Steep Dielectric Collapse near Subcritical Transition: epsilon drops to ~ 14.8 at 350 deg C *)
    rWaterDielectricConstantEst := 16.5 - 0.085 * (rVotedReactorTemp - 300.0);
    IF rWaterDielectricConstantEst < 5.0 THEN
        rWaterDielectricConstantEst := 5.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Supercritical Region: Non-polar behaviour like hexane, epsilon_r ~ 2.0 to 4.5 *)
    rWaterDielectricConstantEst := 3.2;
END_IF;

(* Inorganic Salt Solubility Cutoff: Drops exponentially as dielectric constant falls below 20 *)
IF rWaterDielectricConstantEst < 20.0 THEN
    rSaltSolubilityCutoff := 0.045 * (rWaterDielectricConstantEst / 20.0); (* Near-complete desolvation [g/L] *)
ELSE
    rSaltSolubilityCutoff := 35.0; (* Soluble *)
END_IF;

(* Cyclone Centrifugal Separation Efficiency for Precipitated Mineral Ash (Apatite, Struvite, SiO2) *)
(* Inlet velocity to cyclone: v_in = Q_vol / A_in *)
rTmpA := (rSlurryMassFlowRate / (rSlurryFeedDensity * 3600.0)) / c_rCycloneInletArea_m2;
IF rTmpA > 8.0 THEN
    rCycloneSeparationEfficiency_pct := 98.7;
ELSIF rTmpA > 4.0 THEN
    rCycloneSeparationEfficiency_pct := 95.2;
ELSE
    rCycloneSeparationEfficiency_pct := 82.0;
END_IF;

(* Real-Time Ash Precipitation Mass Flow [kg/s]: Ash% * DrySolids% * MassRate *)
rInstantaneousAshRate_kgs := (rSlurryMassFlowRate / 3600.0) * (rFeedSlurryDrySolids_pct / 100.0) *
    (rSlurryAshContent_pct / 100.0) * (rCycloneSeparationEfficiency_pct / 100.0);

(* Integrate Accumulated Precipitated Salt Mass into Lock-Hopper Dipleg *)
IF iActiveState = 40 (* STEADY_STATE_CO_LIQUEFACTION *) THEN
    rInternalAccumSaltMass := rInternalAccumSaltMass + (rInstantaneousAshRate_kgs * c_rScanTimeSec);
END_IF;
rEstimatedSaltBedMass_kg := rInternalAccumSaltMass;

(* Check Cyclone Plugging / Fouling: Delta P across cyclone > 3.8 bar indicates dipleg choke *)
IF rVotedCycloneDiffP > 3.8 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Cyclone Dipleg Severe Choke *)
ELSIF rVotedCycloneDiffP > 2.6 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0400; (* Bit 10: High Cyclone Differential Pressure *)
END_IF;

(* Cyclone Wall Temperature Differential: Coking / Fouling Detection *)
IF ABS(rCycloneSkinTemp - rVotedReactorTemp) > 25.0 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0800; (* Bit 11: Cyclone Thermal Insulation Fouling Layer *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.0 THERMOCHEMICAL DEPOLYMERIZATION REACTION KINETICS & YIELD OBSERVER                    *)
(* Evaluates Arrhenius rate k, Mean Residence Time tau_res, and Phase Yield Splits.          *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Arrhenius Reaction Rate Constant: k_htl = k0 * exp(-Ea / (R * T)) *)
rReactionKineticsRate_k := c_rArrheniusPreExp_k0 * EXP(-c_rActivationEnergy_Ea / (c_rUniversalGasConst * rCoreTempKelvin));

(* Hydraulic Residence Time: tau_res = ReactorVolume / VolumetricFlow [s] *)
rReactorResidenceTime_s := (c_rReactorVolume_m3 * rSlurryFeedDensity * 3600.0) / rSlurryMassFlowRate;
IF rReactorResidenceTime_s < 10.0 THEN
    rReactorResidenceTime_s := 10.0;
END_IF;

(* Biomass Organic Conversion Efficiency fraction: eta = 1.0 - exp(-k * tau) *)
rOrganicConversionEff := 1.0 - EXP(-rReactionKineticsRate_k * rReactorResidenceTime_s);
IF rOrganicConversionEff > 0.96 THEN
    rOrganicConversionEff := 0.96;
ELSIF rOrganicConversionEff < 0.10 THEN
    rOrganicConversionEff := 0.10;
END_IF;

(* Estimated Real-Time Phase Mass Yields [kg/h] *)
(* Biocrude Heavy Hydrocarbon Phase (~36% of dry organic matter) *)
rBiocrudeYieldEst_kgh := rSlurryMassFlowRate * (rFeedSlurryDrySolids_pct / 100.0) *
    (1.0 - (rSlurryAshContent_pct / 100.0)) * rOrganicConversionEff * 0.382;

(* Carbonaceous Hydrochar Phase (~18% of dry organic matter) *)
rHydrocharYieldEst_kgh := rSlurryMassFlowRate * (rFeedSlurryDrySolids_pct / 100.0) *
    (1.0 - (rSlurryAshContent_pct / 100.0)) * (1.0 - rOrganicConversionEff) * 0.35;

(* Aqueous Dissolved Organics Phase (VFAs, amino acids, glycerol, ammonium salts) *)
rAqueousOrganicsYield_kgh := rSlurryMassFlowRate * (rFeedSlurryDrySolids_pct / 100.0) *
    (1.0 - (rSlurryAshContent_pct / 100.0)) * rOrganicConversionEff * 0.420;

(* Net Reactor Thermal Duty [kW]: Sensible Enthalpy + Endothermic Cracking Duty *)
rReactorThermalDuty_kW := ((rSlurryMassFlowRate / 3600.0) * 4.184 * (rVotedReactorTemp - rReactorInletSlurryTemp)) +
    ((rBiocrudeYieldEst_kgh / 3600.0) * 320.0);

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 MULTI-STAGE PRESSURE LETDOWN & HYDRAULIC ENERGY RECOVERY TURBINE (HERT) DYNAMICS     *)
(* Letdown Stage 1: 220 bar -> 25 bar. Stage 2: 25 bar -> 1.8 bar. Cavitation Prevention.    *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* High-Pressure Stage-1 Differential Across Backpressure Choke and HERT *)
rDeltaP_LetdownStage1 := rVotedReactorPress - rIntermediateFlashPress_bar;
IF rDeltaP_LetdownStage1 < 5.0 THEN
    rDeltaP_LetdownStage1 := 5.0;
END_IF;

(* Antoine Water Saturation Vapor Pressure at Letdown Trim Temperature [bar] *)
rWaterSatVaporPress_bar := EXP(11.6834 - (3816.44 / (rChokeTrimBodyTemp_degC + 227.02)));

(* Choke Incipient Cavitation Parameter: sigma = (P_down - P_vap) / (P_up - P_down) *)
rCavitationIndexSigma := (rIntermediateFlashPress_bar - rWaterSatVaporPress_bar) / rDeltaP_LetdownStage1;

(* Cavitation Mitigation & Severe Vibration Protection *)
IF rChokeTrimVibration_mm_s > 7.5 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Bit 1: Ceramic Choke Severe Flashing Vibration *)
    (* Emergency Choke Trimming: Open Choke 4% to shift pressure drop downstream *)
    rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct + 4.0;
ELSIF rCavitationIndexSigma < 0.12 THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_1000; (* Bit 12: Incipient Supercritical Flashing Cavitation *)
END_IF;

(* Hydraulic Energy Recovery Turbine (HERT) Performance Formulation *)
IF (NOT bInhibitHERT) AND (iActiveState = 40 (* PRODUCTION *)) THEN
    bHERT_Online := TRUE;
    (* Net Hydraulic Head [m]: H = DeltaP * 10^5 / (rho * g) *)
    rHERT_HydraulicHead_m := (rDeltaP_LetdownStage1 * 100000.0) / (rSlurryFeedDensity * c_rGravityAcc);
    
    (* Theoretical Hydraulic Power Exergy [kW]: P_hyd = Q * DeltaP / 36000 *)
    rHERT_IdealHydPower_kW := ((rSlurryMassFlowRate / rSlurryFeedDensity) * rDeltaP_LetdownStage1) / 36.0;
    
    (* Turbine Efficiency Curve: Peak 72% at 2950 rpm *)
    rTmpDelta := (rHERT_ShaftSpeed_rpm / 2950.0) - 1.0;
    rHERT_EfficiencyCoeff := 0.725 * (1.0 - (1.8 * rTmpDelta * rTmpDelta));
    IF rHERT_EfficiencyCoeff < 0.20 THEN
        rHERT_EfficiencyCoeff := 0.20;
    END_IF;
    
    (* Net Electrical Power Generated and Exported to Plant DC Bus [kW] *)
    rSpecificEnergyRecovery_kW := rHERT_IdealHydPower_kW * rHERT_EfficiencyCoeff * 0.94; (* Generator eff 94% *)
    rHERT_SpeedDemand_rpm := 2950.0;
ELSE
    bHERT_Online := FALSE;
    rSpecificEnergyRecovery_kW := 0.0;
    rHERT_SpeedDemand_rpm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Secondary Stage Aqueous Phase Flash Letdown Control (25 bar -> 1.8 bar) *)
(* Regulates Intermediate Flash Level around 48% and Pressure at 25 bar *)
rLetdownStage2Demand_pct := 32.5 + (1.2 * (rFlashLiquidLevel_pct - 48.0)) + (0.8 * (rIntermediateFlashPress_bar - 25.0));
IF rLetdownStage2Demand_pct > 90.0 THEN
    rLetdownStage2Demand_pct := 90.0;
ELSIF rLetdownStage2Demand_pct < 10.0 THEN
    rLetdownStage2Demand_pct := 10.0;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 8.0 6-STATE CONSTRAINED MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION ENGINE                *)
(* Computes state deviations, one-step ahead prediction, analytical QP Hessian & gradient,   *)
(* and optimal constrained control increments for dynamic backpressure and feed drive.       *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Calculate State Deviation Vector x from Nominal Equilibrium Operating Point *)
x1_PressDev      := rVotedReactorPress - c_rNominalReactorPressure_bar;
x2_FlowDev       := rSlurryMassFlowRate - c_rNominalSlurryRate_kgh;
x3_TempDev       := rVotedReactorTemp - c_rNominalReactorTemp_degC;
x4_CycDiffDev    := rVotedCycloneDiffP - 1.85;
x5_FlashPressDev := rIntermediateFlashPress_bar - c_rNominalFlash1Pressure_bar;
x6_HertTorqueDev := (rHERT_RecoveredPower_kW * 3.14159 / (rHERT_ShaftSpeed_rpm * 0.10472)) - 145.0;

(* State Prediction: x_pred = Ad * x *)
x1_Pred := Ad_11*x1_PressDev + Ad_12*x2_FlowDev + Ad_13*x3_TempDev + Ad_14*x4_CycDiffDev + Ad_15*x5_FlashPressDev + Ad_16*x6_HertTorqueDev;
x2_Pred := Ad_21*x1_PressDev + Ad_22*x2_FlowDev + Ad_23*x3_TempDev + Ad_24*x4_CycDiffDev + Ad_25*x5_FlashPressDev + Ad_26*x6_HertTorqueDev;
x3_Pred := Ad_31*x1_PressDev + Ad_32*x2_FlowDev + Ad_33*x3_TempDev + Ad_34*x4_CycDiffDev + Ad_35*x5_FlashPressDev + Ad_36*x6_HertTorqueDev;
x4_Pred := Ad_41*x1_PressDev + Ad_42*x2_FlowDev + Ad_43*x3_TempDev + Ad_44*x4_CycDiffDev + Ad_45*x5_FlashPressDev + Ad_46*x6_HertTorqueDev;
x5_Pred := Ad_51*x1_PressDev + Ad_52*x2_FlowDev + Ad_53*x3_TempDev + Ad_54*x4_CycDiffDev + Ad_55*x5_FlashPressDev + Ad_56*x6_HertTorqueDev;
x6_Pred := Ad_61*x1_PressDev + Ad_62*x2_FlowDev + Ad_63*x3_TempDev + Ad_64*x4_CycDiffDev + Ad_65*x5_FlashPressDev + Ad_66*x6_HertTorqueDev;

(* Analytical Quadratic Hessian Matrix: H = 2 * (B^T * Q * B + R) *)
rHessian_11 := 2.0 * (
    (Bd_11*Bd_11*rMPC_Q_Press) +
    (Bd_21*Bd_21*rMPC_Q_Flow) +
    (Bd_31*Bd_31*rMPC_Q_Temp) +
    (Bd_41*Bd_41*rMPC_Q_CycP) +
    (Bd_51*Bd_51*rMPC_Q_FlashP) +
    (Bd_61*Bd_61*rMPC_Q_HertTorque) +
    rMPC_R_dChoke);

rHessian_12 := 2.0 * (
    (Bd_11*Bd_12*rMPC_Q_Press) +
    (Bd_21*Bd_22*rMPC_Q_Flow) +
    (Bd_31*Bd_32*rMPC_Q_Temp) +
    (Bd_41*Bd_42*rMPC_Q_CycP) +
    (Bd_51*Bd_52*rMPC_Q_FlashP) +
    (Bd_61*Bd_62*rMPC_Q_HertTorque));

rHessian_22 := 2.0 * (
    (Bd_12*Bd_12*rMPC_Q_Press) +
    (Bd_22*Bd_22*rMPC_Q_Flow) +
    (Bd_32*Bd_32*rMPC_Q_Temp) +
    (Bd_42*Bd_42*rMPC_Q_CycP) +
    (Bd_52*Bd_52*rMPC_Q_FlashP) +
    (Bd_62*Bd_62*rMPC_Q_HertTorque) +
    rMPC_R_dPumpSpeed);

(* Hessian Determinant *)
rDetHessian := (rHessian_11 * rHessian_22) - (rHessian_12 * rHessian_12);
IF rDetHessian < 0.001 THEN
    rDetHessian := 0.001; (* Regularization to prevent singularity *)
END_IF;

(* Analytical Cost Function Gradient Vector: g = 2 * B^T * Q * x_pred *)
rGrad_1 := 2.0 * (
    (Bd_11 * rMPC_Q_Press * x1_Pred) +
    (Bd_21 * rMPC_Q_Flow * x2_Pred) +
    (Bd_31 * rMPC_Q_Temp * x3_Pred) +
    (Bd_41 * rMPC_Q_CycP * x4_Pred) +
    (Bd_51 * rMPC_Q_FlashP * x5_Pred) +
    (Bd_61 * rMPC_Q_HertTorque * x6_Pred));

rGrad_2 := 2.0 * (
    (Bd_12 * rMPC_Q_Press * x1_Pred) +
    (Bd_22 * rMPC_Q_Flow * x2_Pred) +
    (Bd_32 * rMPC_Q_Temp * x3_Pred) +
    (Bd_42 * rMPC_Q_CycP * x4_Pred) +
    (Bd_52 * rMPC_Q_FlashP * x5_Pred) +
    (Bd_62 * rMPC_Q_HertTorque * x6_Pred));

(* Unconstrained Quadratic Step: Delta_u = - H^-1 * g *)
rOptDeltaChoke     := -(( rHessian_22 * rGrad_1) - (rHessian_12 * rGrad_2)) / rDetHessian;
rOptDeltaPumpSpeed := -((-rHessian_12 * rGrad_1) + (rHessian_11 * rGrad_2)) / rDetHessian;

(* Enforce Slew Rate Constraints per Execution Scan *)
IF rOptDeltaChoke > c_rMaxDeltaChokePct THEN
    rOptDeltaChoke := c_rMaxDeltaChokePct;
ELSIF rOptDeltaChoke < -c_rMaxDeltaChokePct THEN
    rOptDeltaChoke := -c_rMaxDeltaChokePct;
END_IF;

IF rOptDeltaPumpSpeed > c_rMaxDeltaPumpSpeedRpm THEN
    rOptDeltaPumpSpeed := c_rMaxDeltaPumpSpeedRpm;
ELSIF rOptDeltaPumpSpeed < -c_rMaxDeltaPumpSpeedRpm THEN
    rOptDeltaPumpSpeed := -c_rMaxDeltaPumpSpeedRpm;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 9.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (SEQUENTIAL CONTROL LOGIC)                           *)
(* Manages Cold Idle, Preheat, Supercritical Transition, Slurry Feed, Steady-State, Salt     *)
(* Blowdown, Hot Water Flush, Controlled Cooldown, and Emergency SIS Trip.                   *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* ========================================================================= *)
       (* STATE 0: COLD INACTIVE IDLE / NITROGEN PURGED STANDBY                     *)
       (* ========================================================================= *)
        bSystemRunning                  := FALSE;
        bSystemReady                    := bEmergencyStop AND (NOT bSystemTrip);
        rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm        := 0.0;
        rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rSaltBlowdownValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rHERT_SpeedDemand_rpm           := 0.0;
        rLetdownStage2Demand_pct        := 0.0;
        rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW     := 0.0;
        rQuenchInjectionValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
        rSaltWashWaterPumpDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rStateTimerAccumSec             := 0.0;
        
        dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000;
        dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* State 0 Active *)
        
        IF bEnableSystem AND bSystemReady THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Water Preheat & Pressurization *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* ======================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 10: AUXILIARY DI WATER PREHEAT & HYDRAULIC PRESSURIZATION          *)
        (* Carrier: Demineralized Water. Pressurizing to 180 bar, Heating to 280 deg C*)
        (* ======================================================================== *)
        bSystemRunning      := TRUE;
        rStateTimerAccumSec := rStateTimerAccumSec + c_rScanTimeSec;
        
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000) OR 16#0000_0002;
        
        (* Slowly Ramp Water Feed Pump to Build Initial Backpressure *)
        IF rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm < 45.0 THEN
            rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm := rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm + 0.15;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Modulate Dynamic Backpressure Valve to Target 180 bar on Carrier Water *)
        IF rVotedReactorPress < 175.0 THEN
            rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := 14.0; (* Restricted to pack lines *)
        ELSE
            rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := 22.0 + (0.35 * (rVotedReactorPress - 180.0));
        END_IF;
        
        (* Fire Shell-and-Tube Heater to 280 deg C *)
        rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW := 380.0;
        
        (* Transition Criteria: Pressure >= 175 bar AND Core Temp >= 275 deg C *)
        IF (rVotedReactorPress >= 175.0) AND (rVotedReactorTemp >= 275.0) THEN
            iState := 20; (* Transition to Subcritical Transition *)
            rStateTimerAccumSec := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 80; (* Abort to Controlled Depressurization *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* ======================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 20: SUBCRITICAL TARGET TRANSITION (220 BAR, 350 DEG C ON WATER)   *)
        (* Brings Carrier Water to Supercritical Interface. Dielectric drops ~ 15.  *)
        (* ======================================================================== *)
        rStateTimerAccumSec := rStateTimerAccumSec + c_rScanTimeSec;
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000) OR 16#0000_0004;
        
        (* Engage MPC Algorithm on Carrier Water *)
        rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct + (0.5 * rOptDeltaChoke);
        rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm     := rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm + (0.5 * rOptDeltaPumpSpeed);
        
        (* Clamp Actuators within Operational Range *)
        IF rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct > c_rMaxChokeOpeningPct THEN rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := c_rMaxChokeOpeningPct; END_IF;
        IF rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct < c_rMinChokeOpeningPct THEN rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := c_rMinChokeOpeningPct; END_IF;
        IF rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm > 120.0 THEN rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm := 120.0; END_IF;
        IF rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm < 30.0  THEN rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm := 30.0;  END_IF;
        
        (* Ramp Burner Thermal Duty to reach 350 deg C *)
        rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW := 450.0 + (5.5 * (350.0 - rVotedReactorTemp));
        IF rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW > 650.0 THEN rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW := 650.0; END_IF;
        
        (* Transition Permissive: Core at 220 bar (+/- 4 bar) and 350 deg C (+/- 3 deg C) *)
        IF (ABS(rVotedReactorPress - 220.0) <= 4.0) AND (ABS(rVotedReactorTemp - 350.0) <= 3.5) THEN
            IF bStartSlurryFeed THEN
                iState := 30; (* Operator approved switchover to biosolids *)
                rStateTimerAccumSec := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 70; (* Flush and shutdown *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* ======================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 30: BIOSOLIDS SLURRY FEED SWITCHOVER & RHEOLOGY ADAPTATION          *)
        (* Progressively diverts DI water to high-solids municipal biosolids feed.  *)
        (* Herschel-Bulkley yield stress increases from 0 to 45 Pa.                 *)
        (* ======================================================================== *)
        rStateTimerAccumSec := rStateTimerAccumSec + c_rScanTimeSec;
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000) OR 16#0000_0008;
        
        (* Apply Dynamic Feed Forward Compensation for Slurry Viscosity Spike *)
        rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct + rOptDeltaChoke + (0.015 * rFeedSlurryDrySolids_pct);
        rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm     := rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm + rOptDeltaPumpSpeed;
        
        (* Actuator Clamping *)
        IF rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct > c_rMaxChokeOpeningPct THEN rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := c_rMaxChokeOpeningPct; END_IF;
        IF rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct < c_rMinChokeOpeningPct THEN rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := c_rMinChokeOpeningPct; END_IF;
        IF rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm > c_rMaxPumpSpeedRpm THEN rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm := c_rMaxPumpSpeedRpm; END_IF;
        IF rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm < c_rMinPumpSpeedRpm THEN rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm := c_rMinPumpSpeedRpm; END_IF;
        
        (* Heat duty adjusts for solids sensible heat *)
        rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW := 480.0 + (3.8 * (350.0 - rVotedReactorTemp));
        
        (* When Slurry Mass Flow reaches steady 3500 kg/h for >= 60s -> Production State *)
        IF (rStateTimerAccumSec >= 60.0) AND (rSlurryMassFlowRate >= 3200.0) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Steady-State Continuous Hydrothermal Liquefaction *)
            rStateTimerAccumSec := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 70; (* Abort to Hot Water Purge *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* ======================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 40: STEADY-STATE CONTINUOUS HTL CO-LIQUEFACTION                     *)
        (* Full 220 bar, 350 deg C biocrude synthesis, HERT online, MPC active.     *)
        (* ======================================================================== *)
        rStateTimerAccumSec := rStateTimerAccumSec + c_rScanTimeSec;
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000) OR 16#0000_0010;
        
        (* Execute Full 6-State Constrained MPC Output Updates *)
        rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct + rOptDeltaChoke;
        rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm     := rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm + rOptDeltaPumpSpeed;
        
        (* Saturation Bounds Protection *)
        IF rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct > c_rMaxChokeOpeningPct THEN rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := c_rMaxChokeOpeningPct; END_IF;
        IF rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct < c_rMinChokeOpeningPct THEN rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := c_rMinChokeOpeningPct; END_IF;
        IF rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm > c_rMaxPumpSpeedRpm THEN rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm := c_rMaxPumpSpeedRpm; END_IF;
        IF rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm < c_rMinPumpSpeedRpm THEN rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm := c_rMinPumpSpeedRpm; END_IF;
        
        (* Closed-Loop Trim for Reactor Burner Duty *)
        rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW := 460.0 + (8.5 * (350.0 - rVotedReactorTemp));
        IF rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW > 750.0 THEN rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW := 750.0; END_IF;
        IF rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW < 50.0  THEN rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW := 50.0;  END_IF;
        
        (* Periodic or Salt-Inventory Triggered Lock-Hopper Cyclone Blowdown *)
        IF (rEstimatedSaltBedMass_kg >= 45.0) OR (rStateTimerAccumSec >= 1800.0) OR bForceCycloneBlowdown THEN
            iState := 50; (* Trigger Salt Blowdown Sequence *)
            iBlowdownSubStep := 0;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Graceful Degradation Trigger *)
        IF bDegradedMode THEN
            dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_2000; (* Running in Degraded 1oo2 Sensor Mode *)
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bEnableSystem OR bWaterFlushCommand THEN
            iState := 70; (* Transition to Hot Water Flush *)
            rStateTimerAccumSec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    50: (* ======================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 50: SUPERCRITICAL CYCLONE SALT BLOWDOWN & LOCK-HOPPER FLUSH CYCLE  *)
        (* Discharges precipitated dense mineral salts without disrupting 220 bar.  *)
        (* ======================================================================== *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000) OR 16#0000_0020;
        bCyclonePurgeActive := TRUE;
        
        (* Sub-step sequence for lock-hopper depressurization and cold flush *)
        CASE iBlowdownSubStep OF
            0: (* Isolate upper lock-hopper valve & inject high-pressure wash water *)
                rSaltWashWaterPumpDemand_pct := 85.0;
                tonSaltBlowdownPulse(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
                IF tonSaltBlowdownPulse.Q THEN
                    tonSaltBlowdownPulse(IN := FALSE);
                    iBlowdownSubStep := 1;
                END_IF;
                
            1: (* Open lock-hopper bottom ceramic drain valve to receiver *)
                rSaltBlowdownValveDemand_pct := 65.0;
                tonSaltBlowdownPulse(IN := TRUE, PT := T#8S);
                IF tonSaltBlowdownPulse.Q THEN
                    tonSaltBlowdownPulse(IN := FALSE);
                    iBlowdownSubStep := 2;
                END_IF;
                
            2: (* Close drain valve, repressurize lock-hopper to 220 bar with water *)
                rSaltBlowdownValveDemand_pct := 0.0;
                rSaltWashWaterPumpDemand_pct := 100.0;
                tonSaltBlowdownPulse(IN := TRUE, PT := T#6S);
                IF tonSaltBlowdownPulse.Q THEN
                    tonSaltBlowdownPulse(IN := FALSE);
                    rSaltWashWaterPumpDemand_pct := 0.0;
                    rInternalAccumSaltMass := 0.0; (* Reset salt inventory *)
                    bCyclonePurgeActive := FALSE;
                    iState := 40; (* Return to steady-state HTL *)
                    rStateTimerAccumSec := 0.0;
                END_IF;
        END_CASE;

    60: (* ======================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 60: DEGRADED PRESSURE RELIEF & RECOVERY MODE                       *)
        (* Active during sensor drift or severe vibration; trims feed to 60%.       *)
        (* ======================================================================== *)
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000) OR 16#0000_0040;
        
        (* Derate Slurry Feed Pump to 60% Capacity to reduce line shear stress *)
        IF rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm > 75.0 THEN
            rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm := rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm - 0.25;
        END_IF;
        
        (* Modulate BPCV Choke with widened proportional band *)
        rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := 28.0 + (0.45 * (rVotedReactorPress - 220.0));
        
        IF (NOT bDegradedMode) AND (rChokeTrimVibration_mm_s < 3.0) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Recover to Steady-State *)
        END_IF;
        
        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 70;
        END_IF;

    70: (* ======================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 70: HIGH-PRESSURE HOT DEMINERALIZED WATER FLUSH & PURGE            *)
        (* Displaces bio-slurry with hot DI water to prevent coking during shutdown.*)
        (* ======================================================================== *)
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        rStateTimerAccumSec := rStateTimerAccumSec + c_rScanTimeSec;
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000) OR 16#0000_0080;
        
        (* Shift feed from Biosolids to Hot DI Water Carrier *)
        rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm     := 60.0;
        rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := 26.0 + (0.35 * (rVotedReactorPress - 200.0));
        rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW  := 180.0; (* Lower burner to initiate cooldown *)
        
        (* Run flush for 300 seconds (2.5 system hydraulic changeovers) *)
        tonFlushDuration(IN := TRUE, PT := T#300S);
        IF tonFlushDuration.Q THEN
            tonFlushDuration(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 80; (* Transition to Controlled Depressurization *)
            rStateTimerAccumSec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    80: (* ======================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 80: CONTROLLED PRESSURE LETDOWN & COOLDOWN                         *)
        (* Safely depressurizes the plant from 200 bar down to atmospheric.          *)
        (* ======================================================================== *)
        rStateTimerAccumSec := rStateTimerAccumSec + c_rScanTimeSec;
        dwSystemStatusWord := (dwSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFF_0000) OR 16#0000_0100;
        
        (* Stop Feed Pump *)
        rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm := 0.0;
        rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW := 0.0;
        rHERT_SpeedDemand_rpm := 0.0;
        
        (* Gradually Open Choke to bleed pressure down at <= 10 bar / min *)
        IF rVotedReactorPress > 5.0 THEN
            IF rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct < 65.0 THEN
                rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct + 0.05;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct := 100.0; (* Completely vented *)
            iState := 0; (* Return to Cold Idle *)
            bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        END_IF;

    90: (* ======================================================================== *)
        (* STATE 90: EMERGENCY BLOWDOWN & SIS SAFETY QUENCH TRIP                    *)
        (* Latched Safety State: Hard shutoff, cold quench injection, alarms active.*)
        (* ======================================================================== *)
        bSystemRunning                  := FALSE;
        bSystemTrip                     := TRUE;
        rFeedPumpSpeedDemand_rpm        := 0.0;
        rBackpressureChokeDemand_pct    := 18.0; (* Controlled pressure bleed to quench drum *)
        rSaltBlowdownValveDemand_pct    := 0.0;
        rHERT_SpeedDemand_rpm           := 0.0;
        rLetdownStage2Demand_pct        := 50.0;
        rReactorBurnerDutyDemand_kW     := 0.0;
        rQuenchInjectionValveDemand_pct := 100.0; (* Full deluge cold quench *)
